name: Sauder Furniture and Design Studio
old_description: "Sauder's is simply an unexpected treasure, located in small town Roanoke. Great staff, great prices, great customer service. What more can you ask for? Check them out!"
about:
Sauder Furniture and Design Studio operates from a 20,000-square-foot location in Roanoke, Illinois. The business traces its roots to 1907 when Grandpa Sauder founded the company, and it has remained family-owned across five generations. Current leadership includes fifth-generation owner Wade Sauder, who serves as president and customer relations associate, and fourth-generation co-owner Jeff Sauder, who oversees flooring installation and customer relations.

The company functions as a full-service furniture store and design studio, offering in-stock furniture across six showrooms — including sofas, loveseats, chairs, recliners, sectionals, bedroom sets, mattresses, and dining collections. Beyond furniture, Sauder’s carries flooring lines such as carpet, hardwood, luxury vinyl plank, and tile, and provides measure-and-install services for both flooring and window treatments. An in-house design team consults with clients on space planning and product selection, while a professional installation crew handles delivery and setup.

Sauder’s primarily serves residential customers throughout Central Illinois and the broader Midwest. Homeowners work with design consultants like Mary Lou Littlejohn to furnish and remodel living spaces, while the installation team coordinates projects from flooring to window coverings. The store also stocks home decor, candles, and fashion accessories, catering to walk-in shoppers and design clients alike.

The company emphasizes its family-owned heritage and community focus as differentiators. Leadership describes great customer service as a tradition and a way of life, and the staff — many of whom are local residents — take pride in serving neighbors and friends. The combination of a large showroom, integrated design services, and professional installation under one roof is presented as a full-service experience that sets Sauder’s apart from typical furniture retailers.

name: Savant Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Need thousands of parts laser cut, bent, and powder coated under one roof? Savant Mfg is the place for you.
about:
Savant Manufacturing Inc. (SMI) operates from Kinder, Louisiana, where it was formally established in 1985 after founder Kevin Savant began building four‑wheeler racks in his backyard in 1978. The company remains a self‑made, privately held business rooted in the Gulf Coast region.

SMI runs a full‑service metal fabrication shop under one roof, offering laser cutting (including a 6 kW fiber laser), CNC press‑brake bending up to 12 ft wide, turret punching, plasma cutting, saw cutting, CNC milling and turning, drilling and tapping, robotic welding, and an automated powder‑coating line with chemical pre‑treatment. The facility also houses a FARO Arm CMM for inspection and uses SolidWorks and AutoCAD for design and programming. The company advertises capacity for “thousands of parts” and mass‑production runs, though specific floor space or headcount figures are not published.

The core market is the ATV/UTV accessory sector – front and rear racks, drop racks, floor boards, gun racks, stick shifts and similar parts – which SMI has supplied since its inception. Beyond that, the shop serves a broader base of prototype and production customers across the southern United States, leveraging a partner network for any processes not kept in‑house.

SMI emphasizes a multi‑stage quality system: every weld is checked by the welder, then re‑checked by the buffer and painter; painters are reviewed by packers; packers by shippers. The automated powder‑coat line, in‑house CAD/CAM capability, and the practice of custom‑fitting each new ATV model year are cited as key differentiators.
